description: The clean Zenodo record now provides three public Excel workbooks on oat cultivation at Kärrbo Prästgård near Västerås, Sweden in 2024. The study compared vertical agrivoltaic rows, conventional ground-mounted photovoltaic layouts and an open-field reference. Workbooks name leaf-area index, weather and crop performance; the article describes kernel and straw yields, thousand-kernel weight, and grain protein and fat. Field observations ran from late May to early September, with fifty-five harvest samples. Zenodo currently lists open access and CC BY 4.0. The article was written while the same record was restricted and linked with a private preview token; current public metadata supersedes that access statement. Coverage is one crop, one season and one field, so it does not establish long-term yield effects or transfer to other climates. A reviewer-assessed simulation use is checking crop-response assumptions in agrivoltaic land-use scenarios. data-dlr-global-rooftop-agri-pv-suitability-maps is related planning context, not a measured crop trial. No workbook or private link was opened. Mälardalen University researchers produced the field measurements and deposited the workbooks.
